options.label: Graphics backend
options.description: How Flycast draws the game. Vulkan is usually faster; try OpenGL if a game shows glitches or crashes.

options.label: Internal resolution
options.description: Draws the 3D picture at a higher resolution for a sharper image. Higher settings cost speed.

options.label: Aspect ratio
options.description: Show the game in its own shape, or stretch the picture sideways to 16:9. Use the game's own shape with the widescreen hack.

options.label: Integer scaling
options.description: Only enlarge the picture by whole steps, so every pixel has the same size. Leaves borders around it.

options.label: Screen filter
options.description: Smooth blends pixels when the picture is resized; Sharp keeps them crisp.

options.label: Widescreen hack
options.description: Draws more of the scene on the sides to fill a wide screen. Some games show glitches at the edges.

options.label: VSync
options.description: Syncs frames with the screen to avoid tearing. Turning it off can help a slow game but may tear.

options.label: Input latency
options.description: Low starts each frame as late as it can still make the screen, so the game reads the controller later and a press shows up sooner (about 25 ms sooner for a light game on a 60 Hz panel). It only acts with VSync on and the Vulkan renderer, and turns itself off while frames take most of a refresh, so a heavy game is unaffected. Normal is the standard timing.

options.label: Show FPS
options.description: Shows the frames per second on screen while you play.

notes: Every emu.cfg setting is Option(name, default, section = "config") (core/cfg/option.h:107), read from [config] as e.g. 'rend.Resolution' (core/cfg/option.cpp:68-108); the GUI saves to the same [config] key (option.h:150-151). A per-game section [<game id>] with keys 'config.rend.X', written when the player turns on per-game settings in Flycast's menu, takes priority (option.h:119-121, 147-149).

Values: emu.cfg is read as 'key = value' (one space each side is dropped, core/cfg/ini.cpp:213-221); booleans are read as yes/true/on/1 (ini.cpp:57-69) and written as yes/no (core/cfg/ini.h:93-94); saved as 'name = value' (ini.cpp, IniFile::save, ini.cpp:253-270).

renderer: pvr.rend is RenderType: OpenGL = 0, Vulkan = 4 (core/types.h:97-105; RendererOption, core/cfg/option.h:409-425; this build's default is OpenGL). The per-pixel transparency variants 3 and 5 are not offered: a player who chose per-pixel sorting in Flycast is put back on per-strip sorting by these choices. Flycast Vulkan resets the SM6115 GPU during play (memory note flycast-a610-reset).

resolution: rend.Resolution is the vertical render height, 480 = native (core/cfg/option.cpp:105; scale = Resolution / 480, core/rend/transform_matrix.cpp:264). 480/720/960/1440/1920 are entries of the menu's list (480 x {1, 1.5, 2, 3, 4}, core/ui/settings_video.cpp:154-161), so Flycast's own menu shows them.

aspect: rend.ScreenStretching is a horizontal stretch in percent, 100..250 in the menu (core/ui/settings_video.cpp:253); the output aspect is 4:3 (16:9 with rend.WideScreen) x ScreenStretching / 100 (core/rend/transform_matrix.cpp:305-327). 134 is the value Flycast itself uses for '4:3 -> 16:9' (core/emulator.cpp:670). A game with a widescreen cheat overrides it to 134 for the run (emulator.cpp:667-671).

widescreen_hack: rend.WideScreen, Flycast's 'Widescreen' ('Draw geometry outside of the normal 4:3 aspect ratio', settings_video.cpp:241-242; used in transform_matrix.cpp:106, 148, 315). The per-game 'Widescreen Game Cheats' (rend.WidescreenGameHacks, core/cheats.cpp:600) are not part of this option.

integer_scale rend.IntegerScale, smoothing rend.LinearInterpolation (default yes), vsync rend.vsync (default yes), show_fps rend.ShowFPS (on-screen counter, core/ui/gui.cpp:1421-1430): core/cfg/option.cpp:72, 106-108; menu checkboxes core/ui/settings_video.cpp:204-207, 388.
emulator.json only passes -config window:fullscreen=yes, so no transient command-line value shadows these [config] keys (transient options, option.h:124-126).
